title: ACDP MCP Tool-Result Record (0.5.0, Draft)
description: acdp-mcp-tool-result/1: the metadata of an acdp:mcp-tool-result body, published by an MCP signing proxy that observed one tools/call (RFC-ACDP-0019 §4). The proxy is the producer; the record binds hashes of the call, never the call itself unless a DataRef embeds the result. $defs/provenance is the value of the io.acdp/provenance key the proxy adds to the CallToolResult _meta (RFC-ACDP-0019 §6).

mcp_protocol_version.description: The MCP protocol revision negotiated with the upstream server at initialize, e.g. 2025-06-18.

name.description: serverInfo.name from the upstream initialize result.

version.description: serverInfo.version, when the upstream server reported one.

endpoint_hash.description: Unsalted hash of the endpoint descriptor (RFC-ACDP-0019 §4.2): never env, headers or credentials.

is_error.description: The CallToolResult isError, false when absent.

salted.description: true when the hashes are over salt ‖ JCS (RFC-ACDP-0019 §4.3).

embedded.description: true when a data_refs entry carries the hashed result (RFC-ACDP-0019 §5).

provenance.description: Value of CallToolResult._meta["io.acdp/provenance"]: either the published link or a publish failure (RFC-ACDP-0019 §6–§7).

salt.description: base64url, unpadded, of the 32 salt bytes. Present exactly when the record is salted.

error.description: The registry's error.code, present only when the registry answered with an ACDP error.
